blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, ILOCOS SUR, Philippines — A motorcycle rider died after crashing into roadside barriers along the Piddig-Carasi Road in Barangay Abucay, Piddig, Ilocos Norte, on Monday afternoon, Nov. 16. Police said the victim, a 40-year-old resident of Piddig, was traveling west on a white Yamaha Mio Gear motorcycle when he reached a curve and slammed into the roadside barriers at 3:30 p.m. According to the investigators, the impact left the victim, with fractures to the right side of his ribs, severe abdominal injuries, and multiple wounds and abrasions on the right side of his body, according to the Piddig Municipal […]...
